settings.headline: Common questions, clearer answers.
settings.intro: A starting point for understanding TraceKit's approach and what to verify before connecting your data.
settings.note: Product availability may change as features are released.

settings.heading: Does TraceKit include Intelligence?
settings.body: TraceKit has a built-in Intelligence experience; external MCP clients are an additional access path, not a requirement.

settings.heading: Does TraceKit connect every platform?
settings.body: No universal coverage is promised. Connector availability and supported event types should be confirmed for your account.

settings.heading: Can I inspect source evidence?
settings.body: TraceKit's product architecture emphasizes preserving provider identifiers and evidence so relationships can be investigated.

settings.heading: What happens to unmatched records?
settings.body: The intended approach is to preserve unresolved records rather than silently discard them.

settings.heading: How do I get pricing?
settings.body: Contact the team to discuss current plans, data sources, and scope.
